items.author: stefanonsense.bsky.social
items.context: Do you know any old(er) strategy PC games that have to do with fighting the undead in a medieval-type setting? Am thinking on the last couple of "spooky month" streams for this weekend and I kinda wanna play something more strategy-y.
items.text: Heroes of Might and Magic III has the Necropolis undead faction and is sold DRM-free on GOG, which fits a spooky stream. Disciples II also has an undead side, the Legions of the Damned.
items.verify: Проверьте, что Heroes III и Disciples II сейчас продаются на GOG.

items.author: megaapple18.bsky.social
items.context: Why aren't there more Helicopter video games? Those were the coolest things from my childhood, like dinosaurs and mechas.
items.text: Agreed, there's room for more. Desert Strike and Comanche were great ones back in the day.
